summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing share repurchases and cancellations. On June 8, 2026, the company cancelled 31,336,908 shares repurchased between April and May 2026 at a weighted average price of USD 5.3611 per share, representing 0.897% of pre-existing issued shares. Additionally, two Class A shares were cancelled due to surrender for no consideration, and 1,230,427 Class B shares were converted to Class A. The company also disclosed open repurchases not yet cancelled. This is a routine capital return via open-market buybacks, not a tender offer or going-private. Watch for continued repurchase activity and potential accretion, though no premium or advisor named.
